title: Counterexamples to magic positivity and Ehrhart positivity of generalized parking-function polytopes
abstract: We disprove Conjecture 8.1 of Hill, Luo, Trinh, and Vindas-Meléndez by giving a generalized parking-function polytope in dimension $14$ with negative second magic coefficient $\mu_2$. A second example in dimension $14$ has negative second Ehrhart coefficient $e_2$. The construction uses a Minkowski sum of two uniform-matroid independence polytopes. We determine the minimum possible largest entry for each sign failure in a specified two-parameter family, give a binary example in dimension $20$ exhibiting both failures, and exhibit negative mixed multivariate coefficients in dimensions $13$ and $14$.
